_doc: #1682 SECURITY (architect decision): no Rust HTTP / SSHd / API / mesh route relays a shell command, EXCEPT the routes listed here. Each is an existing /ipc holder route (data/api-ipc-map.json::ipc_registry, server/src/ipc.rs), kept by rule 16 for the c3 peers-control tools: it runs only after the mesh-only + bearer gate (meshlogs::authorize), only for a peer whose scopes hold `acl`, and the phone side is the shell broker's per-caller allowlist under `caller` (default deny). The AdbShellServer itself stays loopback + token. Guard: test/test-c3-webserver-shell-relay.sh. A new relay route, a changed caller / scope / method, or a lost auth / scope check turns it red. `status` is not listed: it reads the broker's state and runs no command.
